patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — SaneBox and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose SaneBox only if your buying job matches “SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outloo” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than SaneBox's shape. Workflow advantage: SaneBox leans shared coverage; Zoom leans business-phone. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — SaneBox and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: SaneBox is SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or any IMAP account — and triages; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Company-size focus: SaneBox (solo, micro, small-business) vs Zoom (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: SaneBox-leaning — vs Zoom-leaning business-phone.
- Researched limits: SaneBox — Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — SaneBox: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: SaneBox is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid SaneBox if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
